violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Surfaces of the soda machine dispenser are not being cleaned at a frequency great enough to preclude accumulations of grime.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. NOODLES & COMPANY (Inspection Date: 01/30/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly stored between use, not in chemical sanitizing solution, in the following locations: at the cook line where wiping cloths are used to wipe woks between uses.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Plastic food storage containers were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the outlet pipe of the sanitize basin at the three-compartment sink and the flood rim level of the floor drain is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the sanitize basin outlet pipe and the flood level rim of the flor drain shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply outlet and may not be less than one inch.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container was uncovered. The lid on the dumpster has broken off, and the side door was open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. Obtain a new dumpster in good repair with a lid that may close.
